boilerplate_profiles.label: Debugging
boilerplate_profiles.purpose: Find, isolate and fix defects without unnecessary rewrites.
rules: Reproduce the problem before changing architecture.
Prefer targeted logs and assertions over broad refactors.
Never log secrets.

boilerplate_profiles.label: Design
boilerplate_profiles.purpose: Improve UI, UX, visual consistency and editor workflow.
rules: Preserve editor state and user workflow.
Reuse Vue and Vuetify conventions for frontend.
Do not add design-only dependencies unless requested.

boilerplate_profiles.label: Programming
boilerplate_profiles.purpose: Create new project-compatible implementation or boilerplate.
rules: Search existing code before generating files.
Generate the smallest useful boilerplate.
Keep backend, frontend, generated and assets concerns separated.

boilerplate_profiles.label: Refactor
boilerplate_profiles.purpose: Improve structure while preserving behavior.
rules: Preserve public behavior.
Preserve imports, routes, method_map keys and build compatibility.
Keep refactors minimal and reversible.

boilerplate_profiles.label: Visual 3D
boilerplate_profiles.purpose: 3D, materials, scene assets, Blender/ThreeJS/WebGL/NVIDIA-style visual work.
rules: Route 3D work through active visual references before generating code.
Preserve source assets and material semantics.
Separate geometry, material, texture and renderer concerns.

boilerplate_profiles.label: Visual 2D / Illustration
boilerplate_profiles.purpose: 2D design, illustration, Photoshop layers, visual references and redesign work.
rules: Treat visual references as constraints, not as random inspiration.
Preserve layer/source asset intent.
Keep redesign work scoped to selected files/components.

boilerplate_profiles.label: Marketing / Conversion
boilerplate_profiles.purpose: Marketing copy, conversion logic, claims, positioning and revenue-sensitive UI.
rules: Do not invent performance claims or revenue numbers.
Separate measurable facts from hypotheses.
Prefer testable conversion changes over vague persuasion.

boilerplate_profiles.label: Mathematics Correctness
boilerplate_profiles.purpose: Math-heavy logic, formulas, calculations, validation and numerical correctness.
rules: State assumptions and units.
Check edge cases and rounding.
Do not hide approximations as exact results.

boilerplate_profiles.label: Business / Economics / Revenue
boilerplate_profiles.purpose: Business logic, economics, Umsatz/revenue correctness, pricing, reporting and financial reasoning.
rules: Never fabricate financial data.
Keep currency, tax, gross/net and period boundaries explicit.
Use auditable formulas for revenue-sensitive calculations.

boilerplate_profiles.label: Project Tree Translation
boilerplate_profiles.purpose: Translate selected project trees, docs, labels and UI copy without corrupting code/config semantics.
rules: Translate human-facing text only unless explicitly asked.
Preserve identifiers, paths, keys, commands and schema ids.
Respect selected PROJECT_SCOPE as the translation boundary.

boilerplate_profiles.label: Compliance / Legal Metrology
boilerplate_profiles.purpose: Regulatory, WELMEC/PTB-inspired guardrails for legal metrology or audit-sensitive software.
rules: Do not claim legal compliance from generated rules alone.
Separate legally relevant and non-relevant software concerns when applicable.
Keep audit trails and validation evidence explicit.

boilerplate_profiles.label: Legal Metrology Software
boilerplate_profiles.purpose: PTB/WELMEC-inspired software guardrails for measuring instruments without claiming conformity.
rules: Separate legally relevant and legally non-relevant software when the scope contains measuring-instrument software.
Require explicit software identification, traceability and validation evidence.
Do not claim legal conformity, certification or type approval from generated rules alone.

boilerplate_profiles.label: PTB Documentation Evidence
boilerplate_profiles.purpose: Documentation requirements derived from PTB Working Group 8.51 leaflets.
rules: Documents need stable identifiers, versions, page/section references and clear language scope.
Record missing evidence instead of filling regulatory gaps with assumptions.
Keep user/operator/authority-facing documentation language requirements visible.

boilerplate_profiles.label: PTB Risk Assessment
boilerplate_profiles.purpose: Risk-assessment guardrails for measuring instruments, assets, threats and risk classes.
rules: Treat risk class as provided evidence or an explicit assumption.
Separate generic threats from type-specific threats.
Map assets, security properties, mitigations and residual validation gaps explicitly.

boilerplate_profiles.label: PTB Security / Crypto / Time / OS
boilerplate_profiles.purpose: Guardrails for operating-system configuration, live media, time management and cryptographic modules.
rules: Document chain of trust, protected interfaces, key handling and time-source assumptions.
Do not infer cryptographic strength or legal time traceability without evidence.
Prefer explicit configuration evidence over generic security claims.

boilerplate_profiles.label: PTB Update / CRA Lifecycle
boilerplate_profiles.purpose: Guardrails for software updates, software separation and CRA-driven change handling.
rules: Classify change impact before recommending update behavior.
Separate legally relevant and non-relevant update paths.
Record certificates, authority approval assumptions and CVE/security-vulnerability context where applicable.

boilerplate_profiles.label: Create / Stack Blueprint
boilerplate_profiles.purpose: Create a new project abstraction or feature from a configurable stack contract.
rules: Define outcome, non-goals, target path, dependencies, references, weights, validation and rollback before proposing files.
Use existing project evidence and selected Project Tree scope before creating new abstractions.
Keep dependencies swappable and explicitly documented.

boilerplate_profiles.label: Clean Project
boilerplate_profiles.purpose: Keep generated output, dependencies, caches and source evidence separated.
rules: Remove or exclude generated/cache/build noise from AI context and export unless explicitly requested.
Never delete source evidence blindly.
Document what is included, excluded and why.

boilerplate_profiles.label: Do Not Normalize
boilerplate_profiles.purpose: Preserve authoritative domain terms, units, identifiers and legal wording instead of simplifying them into generic labels.
rules: Do not rename or flatten domain-specific terms without explicit mapping.
Preserve legal wording, units, formulas, IDs and file names when they are source truth.
When normalization is necessary for code, document the reversible mapping.

boilerplate_profiles.label: Professional Solution Engineering
boilerplate_profiles.purpose: Engineer complete but bounded implementation slices with traceability, validation and rollback.
rules: Prefer boring, maintainable architecture over clever rewrites.
Define interfaces, dependency seams, tests and observability at the smallest useful scale.
Every solution needs changed files, artifacts, validation posture and rollback point.

boilerplate_profiles.label: Blender Manuals
boilerplate_profiles.purpose: Route Blender and bpy work through official Blender manual/API references.
rules: Use Blender Manual and Python API as the source of truth.
State Blender version, unit scale, coordinate and material assumptions.

boilerplate_profiles.label: Unity Manuals
boilerplate_profiles.purpose: Route Unity/C# stack work through official Unity Manual and package documentation.
rules: Use official Unity Manual/API as the source of truth.
Respect Unity folder/package/assembly conventions when evidence exists.

boilerplate_profiles.label: C++ Manuals
boilerplate_profiles.purpose: Route C++ stack work through standard-library and build-boundary references.
rules: Prefer standard library facilities before dependencies.
Keep headers, source files and build/test configuration explicit.

boilerplate_profiles.label: Germany Government Manuals
boilerplate_profiles.purpose: Route German law, economics, technical and official-statistics work through official government sources.
rules: Use official German government/public authority sources where available.
Do not provide legal advice; produce evidence-backed implementation or documentation guidance.

boilerplate_profiles.label: Technical / Physics / 3D
boilerplate_profiles.purpose: Preserve technical units, physical formulas and 3D coordinate/material semantics.
rules: State units, coordinate systems and numerical assumptions.
Keep visual/material concepts separate from physics/math concepts unless explicitly linked.

boilerplate_profiles.label: Micro Tasks
boilerplate_profiles.purpose: Route small local project operations such as Project to Markdown, dependency inspection and validation snapshots.
rules: A micro task must have one named output artifact, one validation posture and one rollback note.
Do not turn micro tasks into broad refactors or hidden scaffolding.
